title: Second Milan Show Cancelled After Violent Hailstorm Forces 80,000-Person Evacuation
detail: Bad Bunny's second Milan concert at Ippodromo SNAI La Maura is cut short shortly after the set began when a violent hailstorm — with hailstones described as "the size of walnuts" — hits the 80,000-capacity outdoor venue. Organizers initially asked the crowd to shelter in place before ordering a full evacuation as conditions worsened; several attendees were struck on the head by hailstones and treated by Italy's 118 emergency medical service, with the nearby Uruguay metro station closed early to manage crowd flow. Live Nation confirmed the show would not be rescheduled and offered full refunds (ticket price plus booking fee) to all ticket holders, ending the tour's Italian leg.
